configuration_strata.pooling_rule: game, run, model, policy, budget, tool-loop state, and supervisor mode must match

field_principles.action_credit_results: Credit summaries are recomputed from rows, not prior aggregates.
field_principles.configuration_strata: Strata prevent pooling across unlike games or configurations.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time exposes skipped or fabricated reducer execution.
field_principles.exact_outcome_join_results: Join counts show whether later outcomes are exact receipts.
field_principles.experiment_id: The identifier binds this artifact to REQ-ARC-6844.
field_principles.field_principles: Each top-level field states why an auditor needs it.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked verdict names the first failed gate and observed value.
field_principles.headroom_results: Headroom shows whether matched cells could distinguish actions.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The complete_ prefix states the terminal evidence boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: This is deterministic CPU live-receipt audit work, not a live run.
field_principles.invalid_action_results: Invalid-action rates separate bad actions from neutral outcomes.
field_principles.per_game_results: One action or matched control row keeps dose and outcome local.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: The gates show which evidence was required before eligibility.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: One digest binds the audit content except wall time.
field_principles.run_date: The date states when the frozen receipt audit ran.
field_principles.schema: The schema lets later reducers reject incompatible audit files.
field_principles.solve_claim: False prevents an audit artifact from becoming an ARC solve claim.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Source hashes bind the frozen artifacts used as inputs.
field_principles.status: The status separates effect-eligible audits from blocked audits.
field_principles.supervisor_causal_audit_complete_score: Completeness is about audit shape, not effect size.
field_principles.supervisor_effect_eligible_score: Eligibility is 1 only when matching, timing, headroom, and exact outcomes pass.
field_principles.transition_progress_results: Progress, regression, and abstention are reported by stratum.
field_principles.unmatched_cell_results: Unmatched and blocked sources remain visible as diagnostics.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed verdict class prevents unsupported positives.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because exact later outcomes are external receipts.

headroom_results.rule: same-stratum redirect/control exact outcome scores are not all equal
